mapper.sql: id, quotation_id, product_id, match_id, sku_id, quotation_price, quotation_base_price, quantity, volume, remark, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, tenant_id, is_deleted
mapper.select: select c.id as quotationSkuId, f.id as productId, f.`code` as modelName, f.`name` as productName, e.id as combinationId, e.`name` as combinationName, c.sku_id as skuId, d.`name` as skuName, c.quotation_price as price, c.quotation_base_price as basicPrice, d.currency as currency, c.quantity as number, c.volume as volume, c.remark as remark, a.id as packageId, a.type as packageType, a.`name` as packageName, a.size as packageSize, b.packing_num as packingNumber, b.packing_size as packingSize, b.cost as packingCost, b.id as quotationSkuPackingId -- from pro_sed_packing a left join sal_sed_quotation_sku_packing b on a.id=b.packing_id -- left join sal_sed_quotation_sku c on b.quotation_sku_id=c.id -- left join pro_sed_product_match_sku d on c.sku_id=d.id -- left join pro_sed_product_match e on d.match_id=e.id -- left join pro_sed_product f on e.product_id=f.id from sal_sed_quotation_sku c left join sal_sed_quotation_sku_packing b on c.id = b.quotation_sku_id left join pro_sed_packing a on b.packing_id = a.id left join pro_sed_product_match_sku d on c.sku_id = d.id left join pro_sed_product_match e on d.match_id = e.id and e.is_deleted=0 left join pro_sed_product f on e.product_id = f.id where c.quotation_id=#{id} and c.is_deleted=0 and (b.is_deleted =0 or b.is_deleted is null)

select c.id as quotationSkuId, f.id as productId, f.`code` as modelName, f.`name` as productName, e.id as combinationId, e.`name` as combinationName, c.sku_id as skuId, d.`name` as skuName, c.quotation_price as price, c.quotation_base_price as basicPrice, d.currency as currency, c.quantity as number, c.volume as volume, c.remark as remark, a.id as packageId, a.type as packageType, a.`name` as packageName, a.size as packageSize, b.packing_num as packingNumber, b.packing_size as packingSize, b.cost as packingCost, b.id as quotationSkuPackingId from sal_sed_quotation_sku c left join sal_sed_quotation_sku_packing b on c.id = b.quotation_sku_id and (b.is_deleted = 0 or b.is_deleted is null) left join pro_sed_packing a on b.packing_id = a.id left join pro_sed_product_match_sku d on c.sku_id = d.id left join pro_sed_product_match e on d.match_id = e.id and e.is_deleted = 0 left join pro_sed_product f on e.product_id = f.id where c.quotation_id = #{quotationId} and c.is_deleted = 0
and d.`name` like concat('%', #{skuName}, '%')
and e.`name` like concat('%', #{matchName}, '%')

select c.id as quotationSkuId, b.quotation_id as quotationId, f.id as productId, f.`code` as modelName, f.`name` as productName, e.id as combinationId, e.`name` as combinationName, c.sku_id as skuId, d.`name` as skuName, c.quotation_price as price, c.quotation_base_price as basicPrice, d.currency as currency, c.quantity as number, c.volume as volume, c.remark as remark, b.packing_id as packageId, a.type as packageType, a.`name` as packageName, a.size as packageSize, b.packing_num as packingNumber, b.packing_size as packingSize, b.cost as packingCost, b.id as quotationSkuPackingId from pro_sed_packing a left join sal_sed_quotation_sku_packing b on a.id=b.packing_id left join sal_sed_quotation_sku c on b.quotation_sku_id=c.id left join pro_sed_product_match_sku d on c.sku_id=d.id left join pro_sed_product_match e on d.match_id=e.id left join pro_sed_product f on e.product_id=f.id where c.is_deleted=0 and b.is_deleted=0 and b.quotation_id in
#{id}
select match_id from sal_sed_quotation_sku where quotation_id=#{id}

SELECT a.quotation_price as quotationPrice, b.currency as currency, b.exchange_rate as exchangeRate, (SELECT count(1) FROM sal_sed_quotation_sku WHERE sku_id=#{skuId} AND match_id=#{matchId} AND is_deleted=0) as totalCount FROM sal_sed_quotation_sku a LEFT JOIN sal_sed_quotation b ON a.quotation_id = b.id AND b.is_deleted = 0 WHERE a.sku_id=#{skuId} AND a.match_id=#{matchId} AND a.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY a.id

select round(avg(quotation_price),2) as averagePrice, date(create_time) as quotationDate from sal_sed_quotation_sku where sku_id=#{skuId} and match_id=#{matchId} and is_deleted=0 GROUP BY date(create_time) ORDER BY quotationDate

select round(avg(a.quotation_price),2) as averagePrice, date(a.create_time) as quotationDate from sal_sed_quotation_sku a left join sal_sed_quotation b on a.quotation_id=b.id where a.match_id=#{matchId} and a.sku_id=#{skuId} and b.customer_id =#{customerId} and a.is_deleted=0 and b.is_deleted=0 GROUP BY date(a.create_time) ORDER BY quotationDate

select d.`name` as customerName, b.currency as currency, a.quotation_price as price, date(a.create_time) as quotationDate, c.nick_name as salerName from sal_sed_quotation_sku a left join sal_sed_quotation b on a.quotation_id =b.id left join sys_user c on c.user_id=b.salesman_id left join sal_yt_customer d on b.customer_id=d.id where a.match_id=#{matchId} and a.sku_id=#{skuId} and a.is_deleted=0 and b.is_deleted=0

select d.`name` as customerName, b.currency as currency, a.quotation_price as price, date(a.create_time) as quotationDate, c.nick_name as salerName from sal_sed_quotation_sku a left join sal_sed_quotation b on a.quotation_id =b.id left join sys_user c on c.user_id=b.salesman_id left join sal_yt_customer d on b.customer_id=d.id where a.match_id=#{matchId} and a.sku_id=#{skuId} and b.customer_id=#{customerId} and a.is_deleted=0 and b.is_deleted=0

select a.id as quotationSkuPackingId, a.box_mum as boxNum, a.packing_num as packingNum, a.packing_id as packingId, b.sku_id as skuId, b.id as quotationSkuId, b.quotation_id as quotationId, b.product_id as productId, b.quotation_price as quotationPrice, b.quantity as quantity, b.volume as volume, b.match_id as matchId, b.remark as remark, a.packing_size as packingSize, a.cost as packingCost from sal_sed_quotation_sku_packing a left join sal_sed_quotation_sku b on a.quotation_sku_id=b.id where b.quotation_id=#{quotationId} and a.is_deleted=0 and b.is_deleted=0

select a.id as quotationSkuPackingId, a.box_mum as boxNum, a.packing_num as packingNum, a.packing_id as packingId, b.sku_id as skuId, b.id as quotationSkuId, b.quotation_id as quotationId, b.product_id as productId, b.quotation_price as quotationPrice, b.quantity as quantity, b.volume as volume, b.match_id as matchId, b.remark as remark, a.packing_size as packingSize, a.cost as packingCost from sal_sed_quotation_sku_packing a left join sal_sed_quotation_sku b on a.quotation_sku_id=b.id where b.id=#{quotationSkuId} and a.is_deleted=0 and b.is_deleted=0
